name: Pizzeria Arrivederci
description: La cuisine italienne est composée de « passione » et d’ « amore ». Ces deux mots on les retrouve inscrits sur les murs de notre pizzeria mais également dans tous notre pizzas...

name: Bagel Way
description: Bienvenue chez Bagel’ Way Arc ! Découvrez un lieu chaleureux et convivial où le bagel est roi. Nous préparons nos bagels avec passion, en utilisant des ingrédients frais et de qualité pour vous offrir une expérience culinaire unique sous vos yeux. Que vous préfériez un bagel classique au saumon fumé et cream cheese, une option végétarienne aux légumes grillés, ou des créations audacieuses et gourmandes, notre menu saura combler toutes vos envies. Venez savourer un bagel à votre goût et vivez un moment de plaisir simple, mais inoubliable ! L’équipe Bagel’Way Arc
address: 13 Av. de la Grande Armee, 75116 Paris France

name: Da Giuseppe

photo.caption: La pizza du moment avec ses tomates datterini.

description: Fresh and authentic Italian products. Long-lasting artisanal pizza dough made in our local using a balanced mixture of Italian flours, homemade natural sourdough, Himalayan pink salt, ensuring lightness, aromas and digestibility. Fruits and vegetables from the market. DOP “Denominazione di Origine Protetta” cheeses and cured meats cut to order preserving taste and freshness.
address: 76 Rue du Faubourg Poissonniere, 75010 Paris France

name: Nectar
description:
Welcome to Nectar!

Nectar is an effervescent gastronomic haven that offers a multi-sensory, rebellious and contemporary experience in a collective atmosphere. Our team of experts believes that cooking should be a celebration and we strive to offer our diners a moment of discovery and experimentation.

We believe that every bite of food should be a sensory experience. That's why we devote ourselves to creating an olfactory spectacle and an explosion of flavors on every plate. Our aim is to make your dining experience a memorable one.
address: 7 Rue Mayran Hôtel Maison Mère, 75009 Paris France

name: Bistro Chez Pradel
description: Since 1897, the French restaurant Chez Pradel has shone in the heart of Paris's 11th arrondissement. Located in the emblematic Bastille district, this brasserie combines tradition and modernity. Appealing to those who cherish French gastronomy in a convivial setting, it remains a true institution. With its warm atmosphere, Chez Pradel is a must for gourmets in search of authenticity.
address: 3 Rue du Pasteur Wagner, 75011 Paris France

name: Origini - Ristorante Italiano
description: Origini est bien plus qu'un simple restaurant italien. C'est un lieu où l'art de la cuisine traditionnelle italienne rencontre la modernité pour offrir une expérience culinaire unique en plein cœur de Paris.

description:
Bistrot L'Olivier in Paris 18: Savor Authentic French Cuisine at the Foot of Montmartre

Discover Bistrot L'Olivier, a culinary gem nestled in the 18th arrondissement of Paris, at the foot of the iconic Butte Montmartre. This lively restaurant invites you to enjoy authentic French cuisine, prepared with fresh, top-quality ingredients.

The elegant and friendly atmosphere of Bistrot L'Olivier makes it the perfect spot for lunches, dinners, or private events. Its carefully selected wine list pairs beautifully with each dish, ensuring an unforgettable dining experience.

With attentive service and a welcoming ambiance, Bistrot L'Olivier is the ideal destination for savoring delicious moments in the 18th arrondissement of Paris.

name: Les Apotres de Pigalle
description: Eat, Drink, Share... That's Les Apôtres de Pigalle. Short Menu of dishes to share, made out of daily-cooked ingredients Selection of quality wines Vibrant atmosphere Roland, Thibault & Gautier are looking forward to receive you ;)

name: The Frog and Princess
description: THE FROG & PRINCESS is situated in a beautiful part of Paris called Saint Germain-des-pres. It is a cool, trendy bar with a professional & hip young anglophile clientele. International student nights burst at the seams and throughout the week all major football, rugby and NFL games are shown. If you are visiting Paris for the weekend, it is certainly worth taking The Frog & Princess in, and if you are an expat living in Paris it is a great place, located on the left bank, to make your regular haunt.

name: Oriental Bowl - Bar a Couscous
description: A whole new form of fast food in France or eating fast and healthy. With fresh, high-quality products. Oriental Bowl - couscous bar offers you power over your plate. It's up to you to choose and compose your dish down to the smallest detail according to your desires! You will be able to enjoy your meal without unpleasant surprises, to take away or to taste on site.
address: 13 Rue de la Huchette, 75005 Paris France

name: Bistrot Kinzo
description: French and Japanese fusion. Fresh products and a menu that evolves with the seasons. The owner Edward Uchiyama was the Head Chef at the Intercontinental hotel Marceau, worked for Joel Robuchon and at the Four Seasons George V hotel. Come and experience a Journey to Japan and France with our 6 course Tasting menu and wine or sake paring.

name: Alix et Mika - Tartares sur mesure
Les Fils A Maman Paris Grands Boulevards
description: Once upon a time there were Alban, Julien, Laurent, Erwann and Nicolas five foodies, five real foodies, of the worst kind (the one that would 'kill' for an old-fashioned Blanquette of veal with some homemade chips or a sweet Tarte Tatin decorated with whipped cream).Five gourmets, basically amateurs, but who knew WHAT IS REALLY GOOD. Five nostalgics with bittersweet memories of their mum's cooking, simple and tasty at the same time, the one with real products, the one that you long for, the one that tastes GOOD... Yummy yummy... In summary this is the story of five mothers' sons who, because they like to eat and to eat right, got together to give birth to THEIR own restaurant, the one where the food is SIMPLY GOOD. And if you need to check that our food is GREAT, those four mummys' boys invite you to join them at 7 bis rue Geoffrey Marie, 9th district. NB: Lovers of deep-frozen food and canned peas are not welcome. The gourmet and authentic food is more efficient than whichever time-machine, and dives into a wonderful nostalgia...
address: 7 B rue Geoffroy Marie, 75009 Paris France

name: Nirvana Inde
description: Nirvane Inde restaurant in Paris near the Place de Clichy near Gare St-Lazare is truly a bit of Indian heaven right here in the 8th arrondissement. The brilliantly vivid d��cor in tones of luxurious purple, red, green and gold, the authentic furnishings, beautifully carved chairs and ambience-enhancing music all create a haven of tranquility. The service is professional and swift, so you can concentrate on superbly spiced dishes like chicken or salmon tikka, lamb rogan josh, chicken korma, or goan prawn curry. The menus are good value and there is a charming terrace for al fresco dining.
